optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Reliability Statistician, Industrial Pump Fleet Analytics
professionalSummary: Reliability analyst with 3 years 7 months of experience building survival and degradation models for industrial pump maintenance intervals, and a BEng in Mechanical Engineering with postgraduate applied statistics coursework.
experienceHighlights: Built survival and degradation models for two pump families, delivering interval recommendations to contract customers.
Reviewed field failure data monthly with service engineers under a documented data quality procedure.
Authored model limitation notes and interval boundary statements for customers.
Previously served as a maintenance planning analyst, leveraging failure records to schedule overhauls.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Survival model workbook and interval recommendation note for one pump family, including data platform query references and transcript of completed postgraduate modules.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience in reliability modeling, data review, and documentation, but do not establish that the candidate holds a master’s degree or has completed three years of applied reliability modeling on field data.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to resolve degree status and verify duration of applied reliability modeling.

role.roleTitle: Reliability Statistician, Industrial Pump Fleet Analytics

evidence.text: Education: BEng, Mechanical Engineering, 2018; postgraduate modules in applied statistics at a distance-learning university, two of eight modules completed in 2023 and 2024, no award.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she has 'a master's in statistics' from the distance-learning university and that the modules 'add up to the degree'; asked for the award date, she said the remaining modules were 'paused'.

missingEvidence: Official degree award documentation or transcript confirming completion of all modules.

evidence.text: Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.
building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.
Reviewed the field failure data with the service engineers each month under the team's data quality procedure, keeping the exclusion log for mislabelled failures.

Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.
